answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12477 Country: KW Title: I want to know that, If i am praying namaz (salah) by following Imam then, "is it compulsory to read Surah Fatiha or not"? Kindly give references also. Thanking you! Question: I want to know that, If i am praying namaz (salah) by following Imam then, "is it compulsory to read Surah Fatiha or not"? Kindly give references also. Thanking you! Answer ID: 12477 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 867/729=D/1430) The muqtadi should not recite Surah Fatihah while performing salah behind an imam, it is makrooh tahreemi: في القرآن: وإذا قرئ القرآن فاستمعوا لہ وأنصتوا وفي الحدیث: من کان لہ إمام فقرأۃ الامام لہ قرأۃ (موطا امام محمد، طحاوي، مسند ابي شیبہ) وفي حدیث آخر: إنما جعل الإمام لیؤتم بہ، فإذا کبر فکبروا ۔۔۔ وإذا قرء فأنصتوا (مسند أحمد، مسلم ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
